newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia TABs 2000 avg BBSW minus 12.43 b.p..
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia TABs 2000 avg BBSW minus 12.43 b.p..

text.p: Australia's A$300 million October 2000 Treasury adjustable rate bonds (TABs) tender produced an average margin to the bank bill swap reference mid-rate (BBSW) of minus 12.43 basis points, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said.
Stock Offering Allotted Avg margin Range
Oct 2000 AS300 million A$300 million -12.43 bp -13.10/12.00 bp
(RBA take-up nil, pct allotted at top 50)
